docs.title: Agentic Memory Systems — Analysis
docs.text:
Detailed, daily-updated analysis of agentic memory systems — how they're built, what they store, how they retrieve, and how they perform under load.

This site is rebuilt every time a local agent commits new analysis content. Each page footer shows the source commit that produced the current build.

  • Per-system deep dives

    Architecture, primitives, evaluation, and changelog for each memory system under analysis.

    Browse systems

  • Cross-system comparison

    Side-by-side comparison along the axes that actually matter: storage, retrieval, evaluation, architecture.

    Compare

  • Update feed

    Reverse-chronological log of every analysis update across all systems. RSS available.

    Latest updates

docs.title: Scope
docs.text: The current crop of "agentic memory systems" — long-lived, structured, queryable memory layers built for AI agents — is moving fast and underdocumented. This site exists to make their internals legible, comparable, and tracked over time.

docs.title: How this site is updated
docs.text: Local agents write markdown into the source repo daily. Each push triggers a static build that ships to GitHub Pages. Every page records the source commit it was built from and the UTC build time, so you can always tell which version of the analysis you're reading.

docs.title: Cross-system comparison
docs.text:
The per-system pages cover each system in depth. The pages in this section flip the axis: pick a dimension, see how every system handles it.

  • Storage

    Backends, persistence formats, schemas, mutability model.

    Compare storage

  • Retrieval

    Query model, ranking, fuzzy/exact tradeoffs, recall guarantees.

    Compare retrieval

  • Evaluation

    Benchmarks, datasets, reproducibility, measured numbers.

    Compare evaluation

  • Architecture

    High-level shape: components, boundaries, where intelligence lives.

    Compare architecture

docs.title: 智能体记忆系统 — 分析
docs.text:
针对智能体（agentic）记忆系统的细致分析，每日自动更新 —— 它们如何构建、存储什么、如何检索、在压力下如何表现。

本站会在本地分析代理（agent）每次提交新内容时自动重新构建。每个页面页脚都会显示本次构建对应的源代码提交（commit），便于追溯。

  • 单系统深度分析

    每个被分析的记忆系统都有独立的架构、原语、评估与变更日志页面。

    浏览系统

  • 跨系统对比

    沿着真正重要的维度并排比较：存储、检索、评估、架构。

    进入对比

  • 更新动态

    跨所有系统的逆时序更新日志。支持 RSS 订阅。

    最新更新

docs.title: 范围
docs.text: 当前一批 "智能体记忆系统" —— 为 AI 智能体设计的、长期存活、结构化、可查询的记忆层 —— 发展极快，但文档普遍稀缺。本站存在的目的就是让它们的内部机制变得可读、可比较、可追踪。

docs.title: 站点更新方式
docs.text: 本地分析代理每天将 markdown 写入源仓库。每次推送都会触发静态构建并部署到 GitHub Pages。每个页面都会记录其所基于的源 commit 与构建时间（UTC），让你随时知道自己读的是 哪个版本 的分析。

docs.title: 跨系统对比
docs.text:
单系统页面深入讲一个系统。本节反过来：选定一个维度，看所有系统如何处理它。

  • 存储

    后端、持久化格式、模式、可变性模型。

    对比存储

  • 检索

    查询模型、排序、模糊 / 精确权衡、召回保证。

    对比检索

  • 评估

    基准、数据集、可复现性、实测数据。

    对比评估

  • 架构

    高层形态：组件、边界、智能位于何处。

    对比架构

docs.title: 更新动态
docs.text: 跨所有系统的逆时序更新日志。每篇日志由本地分析代理写入，并在每次推送时发布。

docs.title: 被分析的系统
docs.text:
每个系统都有四个标准页面：架构、原语、评估、变更日志。新增系统时在源仓库根目录运行 python scripts/new_system.py <slug>。

  • 记忆宫殿 (MemPalace)

    本地优先、逐字保存的记忆系统，借用 "记忆宫殿" 这个隐喻：用 wing / room / drawer 与 AAAK 索引压缩组织内容。

    阅读分析
